source review of identity contract, service, migration, snapshot, route and integration cases

findings.finding: finish returns a parallel unvalidated receipt: before/after contain recordId rather than TargetPin ref; proposalId is missing; details is an undeclared extra. It fails the existing strict UspCommitReceiptSchema. after is guessed from pre-write revision rather than querying persisted pins.
findings.required: Use a registered canonical receipt contract and actual post-write pins; preserve compatibility. Assert every identity HTTP result and stored/replayed receipt parses the shared contract.

findings.finding: Resolver validates an old scope but reads current status/location/revision and current lineage from live tables. An old snapshot can report a later code or correction, contrary to exact snapshot reads. Successor IDs are not filtered through authorized snapshot membership.
findings.required: Read frozen identity and relevant lineage from exact hash-checked captured bodies, or reject unavailable exact state explicitly. Preserve selection in resulting snapshots. Test pre-allocation, pre-correction, pre-retirement and target-selection snapshots after later mutations.

findings.finding: An idempotent replay returns prior receipt before scopedManifestTx checks current accessViewId/policyVersion. The officer role check does not validate current snapshot access context.
findings.required: Reauthorize stored-receipt access against current server context before returning it without requiring old data to remain current. Test changed access view/policy and removed reviewer capability for replay and fresh commands.

findings.finding: Boundary adjustment checks assigned status only for the predecessor; the recipient can be unassigned, retired or cancelled. Resolver treats boundary counterpart edges as successor identities even though both identities continue.
findings.required: Require both boundary participants assigned, reject all invalid participant statuses with no partial writes, and distinguish boundary events from split/merge successor identity links. Keep temporal boundary events from imposing an unintended prohibition on later reverse transfers.

findings.finding: Split uses one review.location for every successor; distinct successor spaces necessarily receive the same reviewed location and space sequence. There is no way to supply per-successor evidence-backed locations.
findings.required: Use exact per-record location inputs/pins for successor identities; reject missing/mismatched target locations. Test distinct split successor locators and merge location without changing original codes.

findings.finding: Parcel assertions retain only trimmed ULPIN, role, sourceId and reviewed boolean. H26 A requires literal value, issuer/source/revision, review state and validity, preserving unknown/absent distinctions. Anchor-state consistency also permits reviewed_complete with an unreviewed member.
findings.required: Retain explicit source/revision/locator, issuer and validity unknowns and review state; validate evidence pins and compatible aggregate anchor state. Never invent metadata. Test literal preservation, missing issuer/validity, stale source, mixed review states and contradictory complete status.
